_comment: KAQ — Kim's Asked Questions. THE-FINN owns the content going forward (add entries as Kim asks recurring questions + their settled answers). WINTERMUTE owns the page build (build_kaq.py -> kaq.html). Each entry: section, q, a (HTML ok), links [{text,href}]. Keep answers to the SETTLED conclusion, link to depth. Newest-relevant first within a section.

entries.q: Why do long-form generations fall into loops, and does SaFa (or another join method) fix it?
entries.a: SaFa's win is real but narrow. At the segment join, both SaFa (frame-swap) and slerp suppress the seam energy-collapse — specifically HF-variance, to ~0.82× (not overall RMS) — but neither moves loopiness itself (0.680 for both, identical). Looping is orthogonal to the join method: joins fix seams, loopiness is global. After this plus two earlier nulls (RoPE-jitter, Incantation), the working lever for reducing loops remains conditioning richness (a prompt-arc, hand-written or eventually auto-derived) — not the join mechanism.

entries.q: Why train on longer context (94s / 188s) when clips have always been ~47s?
entries.a: The model has never seen training context beyond ~47s — the working hypothesis (2026-07-13) is that this is plausibly the reason long-form coherence degrades at window scale. Two new arms: T=1024 (95s, local) and T=2048 (190s, LUMI), both goa/lr1e-4/r128, evaluated via loopiness + the matrix bracket. Complements the separate ARC-Forcing line (context length vs. drift recovery).

entries.q: Why did training crop lengths change to T=1024/2048 instead of the old ~T=506?
entries.a: T=506 (47s) was an accident of specifying crop length in seconds (47s × 10.7666 fps) — it tiles badly on RDNA (ragged GEMM/CK-flash-attn tiles). New standard (2026-07-13): crop lengths in frames, multiples of 256 — 512 (47.6s), 1024 (95.1s), 2048 (190.2s). The same rule now applies to eval-render durations too.

entries.q: Which rank is the good option — 16 or 128?
entries.a: 128. Rank-16 adapters are consistently harsher (more high-freq energy + zero-crossing distortion) and lower quality (CE/PQ), and glitch ~6× worse when the DoRA weight is pushed to 1.5. Rank-128 (and 64) hold their quality. Three independent metric axes agree.

entries.q: What about training length — how many epochs?
entries.a: For rank-128, the quality sweet spot is early (ep0–4). More epochs overtrain (CE/PQ fall), fastest at high learning rate (lr3x craters CE 5.81→4.82 by ep7). The exception is augmentation — the aug10 run keeps improving out to ep74. So: more epochs ≠ more quality unless you augment.

entries.q: Did we do the 0.5× LR model?
entries.a: The everything-corpus sweep had only lr1x (2e-4) and lr3x (6e-4) — no low end, until 2026-07-12 when the 0.5× (lr 1e-4) run was launched to fill it. Motivated by the training-length finding: since lr3x overtrains, a halved LR should train slower/more stably and support longer training + longer crops.

entries.q: What DoRA weight (inference strength) should I use — 1.0 or 1.5?
entries.a: By ear across the matrix (Kim, 2026-07-12): weight 1.5 is almost universally as-good-or-better, and training is disentangled — some prompts change little, so the adapter isn't spilling over everywhere. (Hypothesis being tested: high-rank runs are damped to ~s0.35 at train time, so inference strength 1.5 partially compensates → optimal strength should be lower on rank-16 arms.)

entries.q: Can we train on longer clips with rank 128?
entries.a: Likely yes at batch 1. Doubling crop duration ~quadruples attention memory, but dropping batch 4→1 roughly offsets it (break-even VRAM), so rank-128 longer crops should fit. Needs a quick smoke test to confirm before a full run.

entries.q: Can I leave feedback directly on a clip, checkpoint, or model instead of just the whole page?
entries.a: Yes, as of 2026-07-13. Eval pages (currently the model matrix + the goa musicology page) carry a comment box, and feedback can attach at the page, model, checkpoint, or clip level. Each level clears the red-! unaudited mark only at that same level — a page comment doesn't clear a clip's mark, etc. A nightly job merges comments into the run's metadata automatically.

entries.q: Where are the evals / the new stuff? I can't find them.
entries.a: Start at the evals landing. The big cross-model board is the Model Matrix hero at the top; below it the Models index, the Statistics page, and a Recently added strip. Everything else is in named sections (DoRA/avp, a2a & transitions, LatCH, mechanism/interpretability, control/FiLM), newest-first.

sections.title: Metrics & how to read a page

entries.q: The model matrix looks like it's missing prompts compared to before — did we lose data?
entries.a: No — the manifest was always intact (every model ≥12 prompts, 18 prompt ids total). At bracket-only settings (cfg 15/24, weight 2.0, non-standard intervals) the matrix used to hide prompts with zero coverage there, which read as data loss. Fixed (2026-07-13): those prompts now grey out with a '· no clips at these settings' hint instead of disappearing.

entries.q: What metrics do we use / trust?
entries.a: Our established set: Audiobox CE/PQ/CU/PC (aesthetic quality, 1–10), zero-crossing rate + hf_ratio (>5 kHz energy = harshness/distortion), p95-gated onset density (the honest onset meter — plain onset-detect over-fires ~3× on drones), spectral centroid/flatness/flux, BPM. All 14 are in the per-clip metrics DB over every eval clip.

entries.q: How should I evaluate a steering page — many clips are just buzz?
entries.a: Play the α 0 baseline then α +2 (the operating point): does +2 move toward the concept while staying musical? The α ±6 clips are deliberately past the safe range — they're supposed to buzz (it confirms the trust-region limit), so ignore them for quality.

entries.q: Where do long training runs happen now — local or LUMI?
entries.a: Policy as of 2026-07-13 (Kim direct): long runs move to LUMI from here on. The local card stays for renders, evals, and short jobs; both new long-context arms (T=1024 and T=2048) are packaged as LUMI sbatch jobs rather than launched locally.

entries.q: Can we batch metrics on the GPU since clips are the same length?
entries.a: Only Audiobox CE/PQ is a GPU/neural metric, and on our card batching gives ~no speedup (WavLM saturates per clip, ~1.5s/clip either way — though steady-state throughput is much better than a cold start). Every other metric is CPU (librosa/essentia) and parallelizes across cores instead.

entries.q: Is everyone tracking open experiment ideas in one shared place?
entries.a: As of 2026-07-13, yes, by directive: every open experiment idea goes into docs/todos.md's IDEAS-POOL section (one line, effort estimate, lane, prerequisites), and idle instances pick from that pool rather than inventing work or letting ideas sit only in chat or personal task lists.
